data.raw_text:
Traffic advisory – Larry Uteck Boulevard

Police are on scene of a single-vehicle crash near the roundabout at Larry Uteck Blvd and Nine Mile Drive.

The roundabout is closed to vehicular traffic.

Police are asking the public to avoid the area and take alternate routes to avoid delays.
